onboarding.title: Welcome to DocuLens
onboarding.subtitle: Three steps and you are ready. Everything stays on this PC.

workspace.intro: Choose the folder that will hold your documents and inference data. A .doculens/ directory is created inside it and models are stored there too (portable).
workspace.inspect_new: A new workspace will be created.
workspace.inspect_documents: Found {{count}} document file(s). You can import them right after opening the workspace.
workspace.inspect_missing: The folder does not exist yet. 'Create and open' will create it.
workspace.inspect_unsafe: A drive root or the home folder cannot be used as a workspace.
workspace.inspect_locked: Another instance (pid {{pid}} on {{host}}) is using this workspace.
workspace.inspect_stale: A lock file from a previous run was found. It will be recovered automatically.
workspace.browser_hint: In the browser preview there is no native folder picker; type a path instead.
workspace.settings_sync: The path is stored as active_workspace in settings.json and can be changed under Settings › Workspace.

hardware.intro: The detected hardware decides the tier and the recommended model. You can override both in Settings > AI models at any time.

model.intro: Classification, OCR and extraction need a VLM (GGUF + mmproj). You can skip this now; import, search and organizing work without a model.
model.download_desc: Fetched from Hugging Face when online and verified with SHA-256.
model.import_desc: Drop GGUF + mmproj files fetched on another PC into the workspace model folder; they are registered automatically (drop-in folder).
model.later_desc: Start without a model. You can prepare one in Settings > AI models any time.
model.required_files_hint: Copy file names, sizes, SHA-256 and URLs as text to download them on another PC.
model.installed: Installed — you can start right away.

warn.cpu_only_slow: No usable GPU: running on the CPU. OCR may take 2–4 minutes per page.
warn.no_nvml: NVIDIA driver (NVML) not found. AMD/Intel GPUs are supported through the Vulkan backend (P1).
warn.low_ram: Less than 8 GB of RAM. Large documents may process slowly.
warn.cuda_driver_too_old: The driver's CUDA version is below 12.1. Update the driver or use the Vulkan backend.
warn.old_gpu_arch: Old GPU architecture (CC < 7.0): some kernels may be slow or unsupported.

basis.engine_free_vram: Free VRAM reported by the engine

assistant.title: AI Assistant

sessions.title: Chats
sessions.delete_confirm: Delete the chat '{{title}}' and its conversation? This cannot be undone.

evidence.hint: Lists the matching passages of your documents without calling the model. The scope selection applies as well.

assistant.placeholder: Command or ask in natural language (한국어 / English) · / for slash commands
assistant.empty: How can I help? Try one of the examples.
assistant.help_body: Natural-language commands become a plan card (steps · impact · preview) that runs after your approval. Examples: process inbox, last month's receipt total, tax invoices → Excel, move receipts into monthly folders, summarize the selected documents, undo the last rename. Instant commands: /theme dark|light|system|high-contrast, /lang ko|en, /open <screen>, /job pause, /undo. Questions are answered from the reference material with per-sentence sources. Ctrl+Enter approves · Esc cancels · Ctrl+Z undoes.
assistant.qa_hint: Ask a question and the assistant answers from the reference material with per-sentence sources.

attachments.label: Attached documents
attachments.hint: Drag documents from Documents or drop files here: they become the scope of your questions and commands
attachments.drop: Drop documents or files to attach

memory.hint: The last turns of this conversation (up to 8) and what the screen shows (open document, selection, folder, project) travel with every question and command. Chats are stored in the workspace; 'New chat' starts a fresh one.

routing.label: Interpretation
routing.hint: Model: only slash commands and reply / cancel are handled by rules, everything else by the model (default). Rules (legacy): phrase rules first, the model only when they fail.

card.title: Plan
card.only_reviewed: Do not move documents that are not reviewed
card.invalid: The plan cannot run. Edit it and try again.
card.impact_draft: {{count}} document draft(s) (saved on the Compose screen)
card.retention_shorter: The retention period gets shorter — expired data is deleted by the next purge run.
card.ask_back_placeholder: Ask about this plan or say what to change

execution.title: Running · job #{{id}}
execution.gate_notice: Interactive requests are handled at the next page boundary (≈{{seconds}}s)
execution.job_missing: The job is no longer in the job book.

detail.delete_project: Project deleted (documents stay in the library)
detail.classify_preview: {{suggested}} suggestions — apply on the projects screen

aggregate.title: Aggregate — {{summary}}
aggregate.evidence: Evidence: the '{{field}}' field of each document

clarify.title: Clarification
clarify.fallback: What would you like to do? Please be a little more specific.
clarify.no_model: The planner model is not loaded, so the sentence cannot be interpreted. Load a model or switch the interpretation above to 'rules'.
clarify.retry_hint: Reply and Cancel act at once; every other sentence is read by the model.
clarify.reply_placeholder: Answer the question or ask back

ui.define_schema: Create the field set from '{{description}}' under Settings > Forms & fields.
ui.register_form: Form registration of '{{name}}' started (confirm the field grid).
ui.model_download: Download of {{id}} started (job {{job}}) — see the activity screen.

models.title: Settings > AI models
models.recommended_hint: The model that fits this PC is chosen automatically; download or load it and you are set.
models.primary_hint: The AI model the documents are read with. Drop-in folders are detected automatically.

models.no_workspace: Open a workspace to see installation status.

general.advanced_hint: Settings you rarely change, such as how the AI assistant interprets free text.
general.language_hint: Korean is the default for the UI and commands; English works too.
general.scale_hint: 90–150 %. Also Ctrl+Shift+(+/−). Independent of the Windows DPI setting.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: The choice is stored in settings.json and applied to the window title bar. Document images are never inverted in dark mode.

workspace.settings_file_hint: Editing active_workspace by hand is picked up on the next start. A missing path leads to onboarding.

processing.review_threshold_hint: Fields below this confidence go to the Review Inbox.
processing.review_threshold_scope: Applies to new extractions and to 'Re-run validation' in the Fields tab; flags of already extracted documents stay as they are.
processing.audit_sample: Random audit sample of high-confidence fields
processing.hint: How far imported documents are processed automatically, the review-queue threshold and extraction options.
processing.ocr_digital_pdf: OCR pages that already have a text layer
processing.ocr_digital_pdf_hint: By default the text layer of digital PDFs is used as is (§3.4 hybrid).
processing.kie_max_pages_hint: First N−1 pages plus the last one. Raise it for long contracts.
processing.precise_hint: A second sample (T=0.3) lowers the confidence of values that differ. Time ×1.5–2.
processing.dense_reocr_hint: Pages with {{cells}}+ table cells get a second OCR pass at the fine-print budget.
processing.dense_cells: Table cells that make a page dense

privacy.pii_masking_hint: Resident/foreigner registration numbers and bank accounts are stored only in masked form (YYMMDD-G******); the original is never stored.
privacy.retention_hint: Stored per workspace. A daily purge job deletes expired items without the OS recycle bin and writes the counts to the audit log.
privacy.requires_workspace: Open a workspace to edit retention.

maintenance.title: Purge job
maintenance.hint: Deletes expired journal entries, job records, chats, cache and temporary data every day at the configured hour. It can also run right now.
maintenance.summary: journal {{journal}} · jobs {{jobs}} · chats {{answers}} · documents {{documents}} · extractions {{extractions}} · logs {{logs}} · temp {{temp}} · cache {{cache}} · trash {{trash}}

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Editing shortcuts arrives in a later phase. Enter is ignored while composing Korean text.

about.title: About
about.licenses_hint: Only licenses without a source-disclosure obligation are used (Apache-2.0 / MIT / BSD / ISC / OFL …). All model weights are Apache-2.0 (Gemma 4, EmbeddingGemma 2).
about.font: Font: Pretendard Variable (OFL-1.1, unmodified file bundled)

knowledge.title: Reference material (advanced)
knowledge.hint: Defaults for chunking, indexing, embeddings and grounded answers.
knowledge.auto_index_hint: Chunks changed documents after import, rescan and re-render.
knowledge.auto_embed_hint: Embeds new chunks in the background while the embedding model is loaded.
knowledge.latest_only_hint: Superseded editions in a version group are excluded from search and answers.
knowledge.allow_general: Allow general-knowledge answers when there is no evidence
knowledge.allow_general_hint: Off by default (prevents hallucination). Such answers are labelled 'general knowledge'.
knowledge.min_similarity_hint: Chunks found only by embedding similarity count as evidence above this value (0.5 for EmbeddingGemma 2 — tune on your PC).

generation.title: Compose
generation.hint: Reply token caps of composing. Larger requests are reduced to the cap; budgets above about 3,000 tokens are drafted as an outline followed by sections.
generation.max_tokens_cpu: Token cap on a CPU-only engine
generation.max_tokens_cpu_hint: Default 8,192 · maximum 12,288 — a whole document takes over an hour on a CPU.

notifications.job_complete_hint: Shows an OS notification when a batch job finishes.
notifications.prevent_sleep_hint: Keeps the PC awake while jobs are running.

reasons.rule_not_found: Rule not found (it may have been deleted).

actions.register_form: Make a form from the selection

viewer.delete_confirm: Delete '{{name}}'? The file moves to the trash.
viewer.no_image: No page image. Click Re-render to create it.
viewer.tag_placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter
viewer.rotated: Rotation saved. Re-process if OCR results exist.

qa.title: Ask this document

history.text_revert_title: Undoes this edit and every later one, back to the state before it (the original file is unchanged)

viewer.type_changed: Type changed. Re-extract with the new type's field set?
viewer.image_failed: The page image could not be loaded. A page purged from the cache comes back after a re-render.

text_edit.hint: Drag over the words on the image to select them, then press Enter (or 'Edit text') to correct them in place.

text_edit.nothing_to_undo: This page has no text edit to undo

layer.hint: Drag over the words on the image to select them, then press Enter (or 'Edit text') to correct them in place. Corrected words are drawn in blue on white over the image (the image itself does not change). Drag over an empty area to add text.
layer.no_text: No text was recognised on this page. Run OCR with 'Process', or drag on an empty area to type the text.
layer.estimated_title: Scans and photos carry no character coordinates, so the line positions were estimated from the image. Selecting and editing work the same.
layer.add_placeholder: Type the text at this spot

answer.no_evidence: No evidence was found in the reference material.
answer.follow_up_hint: Follow-up questions keep the same evidence. Even when off, a question that points back ('that', 'the one above') continues automatically.
answer.text_only_hint: Answered from the text you sent; no documents were looked up or cited.

search.title: Evidence
search.placeholder: Words to find (e.g. travel allowance limit, 123-45-67890) · matching passages only, no model call

search.semantic_unavailable: Install and load the embedding model (EmbeddingGemma 2) for semantic search.

knowledge.title: Reference material
knowledge.subtitle: Keep regulations, guidelines and past documents in groups; they ground questions, searches and drafts.

tokenizer.label: Tokenizer
tokenizer.simple_hint: The ko-dic dictionary was not found, so the simple tokenizer (words + bigrams) is used. Install the dictionary into the folder below (bundled with the installer, see docs/engines) to enable particle stripping and compound splitting.
tokenizer.restart_hint: Restart the app after installing the dictionary; the next index run re-chunks every document with the new analyzer.

embedding.label: Embedding model
embedding.none: The registry has no embedding model.
embedding.not_installed: The embedding model ({{model}}) is not installed; keyword search only. Install it under Settings > AI models.
embedding.not_loaded: The embedding model ({{model}}) is installed. Run to load it into the engine and embed the chunks.
embedding.reset_confirm: Delete all stored embeddings? They are recomputed on the next run.

actions.reindex_confirm: Re-chunk and re-index every document? Stored embeddings are cleared and recomputed.

wizard.title: Import reference material
wizard.paths_hint: Enter file or folder paths one per line, or use the pickers. Folders include their subfolders.
wizard.started: Import started. Import → chunking → indexing run in the background.
wizard.nothing: No new files to import (already registered documents are only added to the group).
wizard.role_hint: Imported documents get the 'reference material' role and ground searches, answers and drafts.
wizard.drop_hint: You can also drop files or folders here

versions.title: Document versions
versions.hint: Group editions of one title; search and answers use the latest edition by default.
versions.empty: No version groups yet. Register one from the viewer's 'Version' menu.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.hint: Terms and synonyms expand search queries (e.g. 출장비 ↔ 여비).

test.title: Question test
test.hint: Shows which evidence a question retrieves (no model call).
test.placeholder: e.g. What is the settlement deadline?

advanced.title: Reference material (advanced)
advanced.hint: Index and embedding status plus document versions, the glossary, the question test and the answer log. Groups and documents are managed on the Projects screen (common reference material and each project's Reference material tab).

process.queued: Queued behind the running pipeline job ({{count}} document(s)).
process.no_model: Auto-processing was skipped: no vision model is loaded. Load a model on the Models screen, then press 'Process'.
process.engine_off: Auto-processing was skipped: the engine is off. Start it, or enable auto-start in Settings.
process.model_not_loaded: Vision model {{model}} is not loaded; it loads when processing starts.

split.title: Split document
split.hint: A new document starts at each checked page. The original is archived; the parts are auto-processed.
split.none: Pick at least one split page (page 2 or later).

merge.title: Merge documents
merge.hint: Combines the {{count}} selected documents, in list order, into one PDF. The originals stay.
merge.name: File name (optional)
merge.drop_hint: Drop documents to add them to the merge list

schemas.title: Forms & field sets
schemas.subtitle: Registered forms and the built-in sample forms define document types and the fields to extract.

list.empty: No registered forms yet. Start with 'Register form' or 'Create from description'.
list.hidden: {{count}} hidden built-in forms — the tax invoice, receipt and other 0.2 forms. Switch one on to use it again.

schemas.pending_hint: Waiting for the model. Cancelling discards the result when it arrives.

editor.name: Name (Korean)
editor.doc_type_hint: Lower-case ASCII, digits, _ (the classifier's type value)
editor.registered: Form registered. It now feeds the classifier and the extractor.
editor.delete_confirm: Delete field set '{{name}}'? Existing extractions are kept.
editor.test_hint: Extracts the chosen document with this field set (fill rate in the viewer's Fields tab).
editor.discard_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and continue?
editor.name_taken: A field set with this name already exists. Enter another name.

lint.fields_empty: A field set needs at least one field.
lint.key_reserved: value / evidence / confidence are reserved keys.
lint.label_missing: A Korean or English label is required.
lint.regex_anchor: Regex hints must be anchored ^…$ (validator only; not part of the grammar).
lint.regex_feature: Look-around / flags are not supported by the grammar.
lint.enum_empty: A choice field needs at least one option.
lint.enum_large: More than {{n}} options bloat the grammar.

lint.children_empty: A table / group needs at least one column.
lint.children_ignored: A scalar field cannot have columns.
lint.options_ignored: Options only apply to choice fields.

mapping.title: Type → field set mapping
mapping.hint: The classifier's type enum is built from the enabled field sets' type slugs. Registered forms take precedence over samples.

nl.title: Create a field set from a description
nl.placeholder: e.g. Quotation: vendor, quote date, items (name · qty · unit price · amount), total, valid until
nl.hint: Review the generated fields in the grid, then save. A model must be loaded.

form.title: Register a form
form.hint: Finds the input items of a sample document (blank form or filled example) and creates a field set plus a document type. HWPX/DOCX forms are read from their table structure; PDFs / images use the vision model.
form.name: Form name
form.name_hint: Leave empty to use the document title / file name.
form.deriving: Looking for fields in the form…
form.waiting_hint: Starts once the running engine job (document processing etc.) finishes; see Jobs for the queue.
form.confirm: Check and edit the derived fields, then register.
form.no_docs: Documents is empty. Import the form document first.
form.drop_hint: Drop a document to use it as the form sample
form.documents_hint: Pick one or more sample documents. With several, the fields of every sample are found and merged into one field set (items on at least half of the samples are kept; items on all of them become required).
form.job_result_missing: The discovery result was not delivered. Open it again from the Activity screen.
form.discovery_summary: Merged {{fields}} fields from {{docs}} documents ({{dropped}} dropped). Check and edit them, then register.
form.name_taken_title: A field set with this name exists
form.name_taken_body: '{{name}}' is already in use. Another name saves a separate field set; keeping it leaves the field set unsavable.

reclassify.banner: New type '{{name}}' added. Re-classify the {{count}} document(s) typed 'other'?

review.title: Review Inbox

review.threshold_hint: Applies to future extractions and 'Re-run validation'; items already flagged stay as they are.
review.edit_hint: Type the value as printed; amounts and dates are normalised on save.

organize.title: Organise · export

scope.title: Document scope
scope.date_hint: By document date (import date when unknown)
scope.project_settings_hint: Fills the project's folder / file-name templates.

organize.confirm_body: {{count}} file(s) will be moved / renamed. The operation is journaled and can be undone.

history.hint: File moves, renames and deletions are journaled and can be undone per batch. File hashes are checked first; changed items are skipped.

export.title: Export wizard

target_hint.fields: Extracted field values (field set columns per type)
target_hint.table: Tables found in OCR / text layer

export.pdf_hint: A searchable PDF puts an invisible text layer over the page images. The target is fixed to body text.

columns.title: Columns
columns.hint: Choose a type to pick its field set fields. With nothing picked every field is exported.
columns.none_selected: Select at least one column to export.

path.title: Save path
path.hint: Relative to the workspace. Default: exports/YYYY-MM-DD_<type>.<ext>
path.exists: A file with this name already exists.

errors.export_exists: A file with this name already exists. Turn on 'Overwrite existing file' and try again.
errors.path_outside: The save path must stay inside the workspace (outside the .doculens folder).

export.table_xlsx: Save as XLSX (all tables of the document)
export.table_xlsx_exists: A file with this name already exists. Change the path or choose overwrite on the Export tab.

generate.title: Compose
generate.handoff: The generated draft is open. Check the preview and save it.
generate.reloaded: Loaded the latest saved draft: it includes changes made elsewhere.

form.title: Request
form.format_placeholder: e.g. A4 official letter: recipient, cc, subject, body, attachments
form.content_placeholder: e.g. Quotation for Hanbit Co.: 10 laptops at 1,200,000 won each, valid 30 days
form.sources_hint: The extracted fields of the chosen documents are quoted with their sources.
form.excluded_hint: {{count}} excluded reference(s) are applied on the next revision.
form.job_interrupted: {{reason}} You can retry it on the Activity screen.
form.job_result_missing: The draft result could not be loaded. You can open it from the drafts list.
form.drop_hint: Drop documents or files to add them as sources
form.budget_single: {{tokens}} tokens in one pass · about {{minutes}} min
form.budget_split: {{tokens}} tokens — outline, then section by section · about {{minutes}} min
form.cpu_warning: CPU-only engine: this budget can take more than an hour, so the cap is {{cap}} tokens.

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty_body: Pick a form and describe the content on the left, then press Generate. Asking the assistant to "draft a quotation" opens the result here too.

revise.title: Draft assistant
revise.hint: Pick a scope and give an instruction: the AI rewrites that section (or the whole draft). Fields, tables and the other sections stay as they are.
revise.scope_lost: The section picked for rewriting was removed by an edit, so the scope was cleared. Pick the scope again.
revise.heading: New section heading (optional)
revise.instruction_placeholder: e.g. more detail, put the amounts in a table, formal tone

editor.title: Edit
editor.empty: Once a draft exists, edit its fields, tables and body here.
editor.heading: Heading {{level}}

save.title: Save
save.hint: Saves under documents/generated/ in the workspace and registers the file in Documents as a generated document.
save.blocking_warning: {{count}} validation issue(s) need confirmation before saving. You can still save; the document stays 'unreviewed'.
save.exists: A file with this name already exists. Turn on overwrite or change the file name.
save.warning_markdown: Markdown (.md) is registered in Documents as a generated document too (text format) and is searchable.

drafts_list.title: Recent drafts
drafts_list.hint: Generated drafts are kept in the workspace. Open one to keep editing, or delete it.
drafts_list.delete_confirm: Delete the draft '{{title}}'? Saved files are kept.

sources_dialog.title: Documents to quote
sources_dialog.hint: Documents with extracted fields are quoted with values and sources.

generate.open_busy: Another draft is being generated on the Compose screen. If you open this one now, the running job's result stays available on the Activity screen.

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty_body: Group work documents and reference material per review, vendor or task, and verify them with a required-document checklist and consistency rules.

dialog.title: New project
dialog.name: Name
dialog.inbox_hint: Documents arriving in inbox/<folder> join this project automatically.
dialog.keywords_hint: Auto-classification looks for these in document titles, file names, vendors and text.
dialog.end_hint: Leave empty to keep the project active.

detail.checked: Check finished — pass {{pass}} · mismatch {{mismatch}} · undetermined {{undetermined}} · missing {{missing}}
detail.delete_confirm: Delete the project '{{name}}'? Its reference group goes with it; the documents stay in Documents.
detail.complete_hint: Sets the end date to today.

documents.no_checklist: No template: the checklist is empty. Assign a template to see the required documents.
documents.empty: No documents yet. Pick some from Documents or drop files here.
documents.add_hint: Adds documents from Documents to this project. Choose the kind — classified work documents count towards the checklist.
documents.drop_hint: Drop documents or files here to add them as work documents

copy.resync_hint: Rewrites this project's copies from the originals.

documents.title: Documents
documents.hint: Work documents are what the checklist, consistency checks and organising act on; reference material grounds questions, search and drafting (the common reference material is used too). The kind button moves a document between the two.
documents.both_hint: A work document that is also in the reference group. Removing it drops both.
documents.ingest_hint: Imports files as this project's reference material.

rules.title: Consistency rules
rules.nl_label: Add a rule in natural language
rules.nl_placeholder: e.g. the supplier BRN of the tax invoice must equal the registration number of the business registration
rules.empty: No rules. Add one in natural language or create the project from a template.

relations.caption: Shared entities between documents
relations.empty: No shared entities (BRN, amounts, dates, names). Extract the documents and check again.

supplement.title: Supplement request
supplement.hint: Drafts a supplement request from the selected mismatch / missing findings; review and save it on the generate screen.
supplement.none: No mismatch / missing findings. Run the consistency check first.
supplement.ready: The supplement request draft is ready.
supplement.result_missing: The supplement request draft could not be loaded. You can open it from the drafts list on the document generator.
supplement.interrupted: {{reason}} You can retry it on the Jobs screen.

templates.title: Project templates
templates.hint: A template is a set of required document types and consistency rules. Built-ins are read-only; duplicate them to edit.
templates.name: Name
templates.select: Select a template or create one.
templates.readonly: Built-in templates cannot be edited. Duplicate one to edit it.

classify.button_hint: Suggests a project for documents that belong to none, from their title and content.
classify.title: Classify documents into projects
classify.hint: Each document's title, file name, vendor and text are compared with every project's name, keywords, intake number and documents. Review or change the suggestions; nothing is assigned until you apply.
classify.model_hint: Documents the rule scores cannot decide (up to 20) are put to the loaded model.
classify.model_unavailable: No model is loaded; rule scores only.
classify.no_projects: No projects yet. Create one and give it keywords first.
classify.empty: Nothing to classify (every document already belongs to a project).

badge.overdue_hint: The end date has passed but required documents are missing, mismatches remain or no check has run.

settings.title: Project organise / export settings
settings.hint: Templates used when this project's documents are organised, and the folder that holds copies of documents that also belong to another project. Empty = default ({{default}}).
settings.copies: Keep copies of documents shared with other projects
settings.copies_hint: A document joining this project as its second (or later) project gets a tracked physical copy in the folder above; the copy follows changes of the original and is removed when the document leaves the project.

common.title: Common reference material
common.hint: Regulations, guidelines and past documents shared by every project's questions, searches and drafts. Each group can be switched on and off.

reference.title: Reference material
reference.hint: Regulations, guidelines and past documents that ground this project's questions, searches and drafts. The common reference material is used as well.
reference.name: Name
reference.delete_confirm: Delete the group '{{name}}'? Its documents stay in Documents.
reference.no_groups: No groups yet. Create one or import files.
reference.select_group: Pick a group on the left.
reference.add_hint: Adds documents from Documents as reference material; they get the 'reference material' role.
reference.drop_hint: Drop documents or files here to add them as reference material

put.title: Put in project
put.hint: Choose where the {{count}} document(s) go and as what.
put.common_hint: Goes into a reference group used by every question and search, independent of projects.
put.no_projects: No projects yet. Create one with 'New project…' or put the documents into the common reference material.
put.kind_reference_hint: Evidence for questions, searches and drafts
put.kind_reference_only: The common reference material only takes reference material.
put.suggested_none: No project could be suggested; pick one yourself.
put.done_reference: {{count}} document(s) put into the reference material of '{{name}}'.

dnd.nothing: Nothing to add (unsupported type or already present)
dnd.nav_hint: While dragging, rest on a menu entry to switch to that screen
